\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:ae:abstract\endcsname{On eight AliMeeting meetings never used before, a locked test confirms the speech-layer gains: ASR-BLEU +2.23, block-start speech LAAL $-$0.37\,s, EndOffset $-$1.43\,s.}

\expandafter\def\csname n@v11:ae:verdict\endcsname{Against B, \sys{} changes ASR-BLEU by +2.23, the conventional block-start speech LAAL by $-$0.37\,s and EndOffset by $-$1.43\,s (all three pre-registered tests confirmed after Holm correction); speech start moves by $-$0.14\,s and the speaking rate rises from 2.36 to 3.50 words per second.
